verdict.rationale: Signifyd documents Decision Center policies that can be configured at the Sale checkpoint and applied automatically to orders created via that event endpoint (signifyd-docs-23). It also sends webhooks automatically on guarantee-decision events, which can drive downstream actions (signifyd-docs-7, signifyd-docs-8). The rule-definition side rests on a single conditional mention, and webhooks are notifications rather than user-defined rules. Missing for 10: documentation of how policy rules are authored (conditions and actions), rules at other checkpoints or events, configurable automated actions beyond the fraud decision, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
